counting_policy: 50 distinct input/risk/outcome conditions are proposed. Model/engine/language copies, repetitions and parameterized test counts are not new scenarios. This catalog is not 50 completed or human-approved cases.

cross_profile_factors.language: Only each ratified profile existing supported language; this file adds no language offer.
cross_profile_factors.speakers_accents: Representative speakers/accents must be ratified; variants do not inflate distinct IDs.
cross_profile_factors.audio: Quiet/noise, actual intended codec/carrier, cold/warm and long turns as approved; synthetic fixture bytes are not acoustic proof.
cross_profile_factors.capabilities: Use existing configured actions only; absent routes remain unavailable. No new action/provider is introduced.
